name: Blessings of the Great Cat Spirit
summary: After the Great Cat Spirit’s blessing, you are told to return to Dendrite. He senses new cunning and ferocity in you, and says you can now learn to call upon the cat’s spirit.

sections.title: Dendrite’s Reading
sections.body: Dendrite greets you with a gesture in the air, and an aura of power comes over him. He senses the cat’s cunning and ferocity in you, along with a new understanding of stealth and speed. Now he can teach you to focus that nature and call upon the cat’s spirit.

faq.q: Why does Dendrite want to see me?
faq.answer: After the Great Cat Spirit’s blessing, you are told to return to Dendrite, who will instruct you further.

faq.q: What does Dendrite sense in me?
faq.answer: He senses the cat’s cunning and ferocity, and believes you understand the stealth and speed needed to adopt its nature.

faq.q: What can I learn from Dendrite now?
faq.answer: Dendrite says you can learn to focus your cunning and call upon the cat’s spirit.

attribution: In-game quest text: Blessings of the Great Cat Spirit
